title: Nanoscale-surface roughness enhances the performance of organic thin-film thermoelectrics
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37774-37780
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA04591B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Balwinder Kaur, Ezaz Hasan Khan, Anna Maria Routsi, Lian Li, Andrew Latulippe, Hongwei Sun, Christopher Drew, Jayant Kumar, Dionysios C. Christodouleas
The thermoelectric ZT of organic thin-films can be significantly boosted by increasing their surface roughness. Herein, a soft-templating method produced a nanorough thin film of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):Tosylate with a ZT equal to 0.99.
